text: UK inflation cooled to 3.6% in October, matching expectations and increasing the likelihood of a pre-Christmas rate cut as markets price an 80% probability. Core inflation eased slightly and government borrowing costs remain the highest in the G7.

meta.note: Controlled inflation cooling preserves continuity; exposure of structural debt pressure persists while policy alignment toward rate cuts strengthens.

text: The Dutch government suspended its intervention at Chinese-owned chipmaker Nexperia after constructive talks with Beijing, paving the way for chip exports to resume and easing tensions that disrupted global automotive supply chains.

meta.note: Supply-chain flow restored after geopolitical exposure; alignment improves across EU–China channel with continuity preserved.
